customer_updates.text: I visited this shop in Andheri to purchase some items. When I approached the counter to pay, I was informed that if I was paying online, they could not provide a physical bill; however, if I intended to pay in cash, I would have to proceed to a different counter to obtain one. When I went to the other counter, they simply told me, "We've already issued it to you online; you will receive it on your mobile phone—you just need to turn on your internet connection." I then asked them to provide a carry bag, but they refused, stating, "We don't provide carry bags for such small items." This was baffling to me; normally, when you visit any shop—even a roadside stall—if you buy something as trivial as a napkin worth just 30 rupees, they still give you a bag.
